title: AMER Data Analyst - Sales Strategy
location: Chicago, US Remote, SF, NYC, Seattle
body_text: We have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach. Build SQL models and Looker dashboards for the sales strategy team. A remote location is defined as being 35 miles or more from one of our offices; we encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you live. The annual US base salary range for this role is $146,900 - $220,300. Applications are open.
